messages:
Alex K: heads up — I need to create release/v1.13.0 branch for the config-rollup PR. It's a small change to infra config but touches the rollout policy. Can we confirm this is allowed past cutoff? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4521
Maria P: cutoff was yesterday EOD. Generally only critical fixes after cutoff. Is this a behavioral change or just an ops tuning?
Alex K: not a feature change — just reduces autoscale smoothing from 0.10 -> 0.08 to stop thrash during bursty traffic. It does affect routing thresholds slightly. I can add a short changelog line: "ops: adjust autoscale smoothing"
Zheng Li: past cutoff we require release lead signoff for non-security changes. @Maria P @Samira can one of you sign off if this is acceptable?
Maria P: @Alex K please open a backport PR against the release branch and include a 1-2 line test plan. Also add a migration note if behavior differs.
Alex K: will do. Quick Q: should the branch be named release/v1.13.0 or release/1.13?
Samira: we use release/v1.13.0 (semantic patch level) for clarity in tooling. Also prefer --ff-only merges to keep history tidy. Test plan: smoke on staging + 30m canary in prod.
Release Bot: automated checklist — release branch v1.13 not found. If you want me to create it, react with :white_check_mark: and include base commit hash. I will validate CI templates and branch protection.
Alex K: base commit sha: ab12cd34. Creating branch locally then pushing: `git checkout -b release/v1.13.0 ab12cd34 && git push origin release/v1.13.0`
Maria P: :eyes: pinging release lead @Zheng Li for signoff on the backport/branch creation.
Zheng Li: I reviewed the diff. This looks safe and low-risk. Approving branch creation and backport. Please include changelog entry: "ops: reduce autoscale smoothing to reduce thrash" and tag me in the PR.
Alex K: done — backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4530. Added changelog entry to the PR body and linked this thread. Deciding not to hide from release notes.
Maria P: agree — include a short note, ops tweaks are useful for customers to know.
Samira: I'll queue the canary once CI is green. Checklist: verify routing in us-west & eu-central, 30m canary, rollback plan ready.
Release Bot: branch release/v1.13.0 created at ab12cd34 by alexk. CI queued.
Alex K: thanks all — proceeding with cherry-pick to release branch and tagging release-1.13.0-candidate. Ping here if anything else needed.
